status: experimental deployment architecture; no production activation claim
purpose: Create an explicit local record that identifies exactly which imported artifacts are accepted for a specific instance, under which authority source, policy, protection profiles, topology, review evidence, validity window, and rollback plan.
required_bindings: source trust-package identity and manifest digest
explicit rejected artifact digests where applicable
core_invariants: admitting an artifact for one instance does not admit it elsewhere
admission accepts exact digests, not floating names or latest versions
partial package admission is allowed and must be explicit
admission remains inert until a separate activation/effect decision
rollback is defined before activation eligibility
expiry or suspension removes future activation eligibility without rewriting historical evidence
nonclaims: Local admission does not imply legal or institutional approval outside the named authority scope.
An admitted artifact may still be denied at execution time by fresher local policy.
An admission record does not create a reusable cross-instance grant.
This profile does not define a universal organizational approval process.
